content:
incident-bot: Pager -> billing-aggregation-failure: aggregation-worker error spike (>1000 retries in 5m). Possible undercounting of usage shown in dashboard. Triggered alert at 2025-11-07T18:15:01Z. Impact: customers may see lower usage/temporary invoice delays. @Megan (eng oncall) paged. Link: https://incidents.internal/r/1945678901

Megan: ack — taking incident commander. oncall response: I'll triage, assign roles (triage / comms / backfill). Quick asks: scope estimate and whether invoices are affected.

Samir: digging in — aggregation job agg_v2 is failing to commit offsets. Root cause looks like elevated S3 read latency (GETs timing out) which cascades into Kafka consumer retries -> backlog. stack log snippet: ```ERROR agg_worker.py: failed to fetch s3 object 500ms timeout -> retry 3/5
Traceback: botocore.exceptions.ReadTimeoutError: Read timeout on endpoint URL: \"https://s3.redwood-internal/agg/2025/...\"``` 

Robert: CS reports: multiple customers flagged missing daily usage rows around 14:00-17:00 UTC. Example account: acct_0xB12F — dashboard shows 0.8x actual for last 6h. Invoices: batch-invoicer job skipped some aggregates for the 07-Nov nightly run; we may need to re-run after data is reconciled.

Megan: mitigation plan (quick):
1) Serve dashboard from raw-events read path for 1h while backfill proceeds (adds explanation banner).
2) Trigger backfill on agg_v2 for window 2025-11-07T14:00..2025-11-07T18:00.
3) Scale agg worker pool to 6 replicas, bump S3 read timeout to 10s temporarily.
4) Re-run invoicer once aggregates validated.
Commands: ```# scale workers
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/agg-worker --replicas=6
# backfill via airflow
airflow dags backfill agg_v2_backfill -s 2025-11-07T14:00 -e 2025-11-07T18:00 -c '{"priority": "high"}'
# quick reconciliation query (psql)
SELECT account_id, sum(raw_tokens) as raw, sum(agg_tokens) as agg FROM usage_events WHERE ts >= '2025-11-07T14:00' GROUP BY account_id;```

Olivia: status page draft for approval — short copy suggestion: "We are investigating an issue causing some customers to see lower usage metrics in the dashboard and potential delays to invoice generation. Engineers are running a backfill and reprocessing affected windows. We will post updates here and notify impacted customers directly. Status: Investigating." Want to push as "investigating" now and update to "identified" when backfill starts.

Alice (CS lead): please prepare proactive customer template. Recommended approach: 1) notify affected customers proactively with brief summary + ETA, 2) offer automatic prorated credit where invoices were impacted, 3) CS to prioritize top 50 enterprise customers first.

Aaron: drafting CS/email & in-app banner — PLEASE REVIEW. Template below (placeholders: {{account}}, {{impact_window}}, {{eta}}):

```Subject: Notice: Temporary discrepancy in Usage Dashboard ({{impact_window}})

Hi {{account}} team,

We're reaching out to let you know we detected a discrepancy in the Usage Dashboard between {{impact_window}}. Our engineers are reprocessing events now and expect corrected usage to appear within {{eta}}. If this affected invoicing, we'll automatically apply a prorated credit and follow up with invoice reconciliation. No action needed from your side.

We apologize for the disruption — contact cs@redwood.com if you have urgent concerns.

Thanks,
Redwood Billing & Support
```

Samir: quick scope estimate — running aggregation delta query now. Early numbers: ~2,300 accounts with >2% undercount, median undercount ~7%, tail up to 30% for a handful of high-throughput accounts. Query used: ```SELECT count(distinct account_id), avg((raw-agg)/raw) FROM tmp_agg_delta WHERE raw>0;``` Will push full CSV to /shared/incidents/1945678901/ after backfill completes.

Robert: invoices note — nightly batch-invoicer using agg_v2 skipped aggregates for run 2025-11-07-00:00; if backfill finishes before scheduled invoice send, we can include corrected numbers, otherwise expect a 24-48h invoice delay for affected customers. CS: prepare customer-facing language that mentions "possible short delay to invoice delivery up to 48 hours".

Megan: backfill kicked off at 18:28 UTC. Job ID: backfill-1945. ETA ~45m. Pushed UI fallback to raw-events read. In-app banner up: "We're reprocessing recent usage data — numbers may be incomplete. Updated: 18:30 UTC."

incident-bot: Update: backfill-1945 transitioned -> running (task 3/12).

Aaron: CS template for post-fix reconciliation email below — please tweak credit wording if legal/accounting want different phrasing: ```Hi {{account}},

The issue that affected your usage reporting on {{impact_window}} has been corrected. We reprocessed events and your dashboard and invoice have been updated. We have applied a prorated credit of ${{credit_amount}} to your account to cover any discrepancy. If you disagree with the reconciliation, reply and we'll open a manual review.

Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Billing
```

Samir: backfill finished at 19:12 UTC. Ran reconciliation script: `python tools/reconcile_usage.py --input /shared/incidents/1945678901/delta.csv --apply`. Preliminary verification: top 100 accounts reprocessed and matched expected volumes.

Megan: mitigation: mitigated -> monitoring. We retained higher S3 read timeout and left workers scaled for 1h. Requesting Robert + CS to send out customer comms now that reconciliation is complete. Also creating a quick internal postmortem template: ```- Summary: what happened
- Impact: number of accounts, invoice delays, magnitude
- Timeline: alerts -> mitigation -> resolution
- Root cause: S3 read latency + insufficient retry backoff
- Action items: autoscale policy, ~~increase read timeout~~, add backfill retry alert, create invoice guard rails
- Owners: Samir (infra), Robert (billing ops), Alice (CS)
```

Robert: sending invoice reconciliation run and scheduling credit issuance now. Will update when credits pushed.

Alice: CS outbound scheduled: top 50 accounts manual outreach by CS managers, all affected customers get automated email within 1 hour. Template approved.

incident-bot: On-call handoff planned: Megan -> Samir @ 19:30 UTC. Pager cleared for oncall swap.

Megan: closing notes: created postmortem draft at https://docs.internal/incident-1945678901, tagging owners. Marking thread as 'mitigated' but we'll monitor for 24h.

Samir: monitoring shows no new aggregation errors after backfill. I'll own follow-up tasks and backlog the infra fixes.

Olivia: status page updated to "resolved — monitoring" at 19:20 UTC and linked follow-up doc. I'll post final customer status update once credits confirmed.

Aaron: final — please react :thumbsup: if comm templates are good, otherwise reply with edits.

Megan: :thumbsup: 

(END THREAD)
